name: kodxcamp
description: Browser-first, learn-by-doing programming platform — MERN + TypeScript monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules shared/node_modules shared/dist server/dist client/dist
